_comment: Real, provisioned Kelvran pilot dashboard -- wired via docs/operations/grafana/provisioning/dashboards.yaml, not an example-only file (unlike docs/operations/grafana-cache-dashboard.json). Three panels, each backed by a real, already-shipped gateway/internal/telemetry/telemetry.go metric (kelvran.cache.lookup, kelvran.llm.spend_usd, gen_ai.client.operation.duration's error.type="guardrail_blocked" dimension -- see dataplane.go's outcomeFor/errorTypeFor for that last one, OUTCOME_GUARDRAIL_BLOCKED lowercased). PromQL uses the OTel-to-Prometheus-native-OTLP-ingestion name translation confirmed live against this pilot's own grafana/otel-lgtm backend (dot -> underscore, '_total' suffix on a monotonic Sum, '_seconds_bucket'/'_sum'/'_count' suffixes on a Histogram) -- verify against your own collector before reusing elsewhere, per grafana-cache-dashboard.json's own identical caveat.
title: Kelvran Gateway Overview

panels.title: Cache hit rate by layer
panels.description: kelvran.cache.lookup, dimensioned by kelvran.cache.lookup_outcome (hit/miss) and kelvran.cache.layer (hit only). See docs/operations/TELEMETRY.md's 'Cache lookup hit/miss (metric)' row.

panels.title: Budget burn (real LLM spend, USD/hour)
panels.description: kelvran.llm.spend_usd -- real USD cost of every billable (genuine, unshared) upstream call, per virtual key's real Bedrock spend against its budget_usd cap. See docs/operations/TELEMETRY.md's 'LLM spend (metric)' row.

panels.title: Guardrail verdict rate (blocked vs allowed)
panels.description: gen_ai.client.operation.duration, filtered on error.type="guardrail_blocked" -- the low-cardinality error.type value dataplane.go's errorTypeFor emits for GatewayDecisionEvent_OUTCOME_GUARDRAIL_BLOCKED (a pre-call or post-call guardrail Block-tier verdict). No dedicated guardrail counter exists yet; this is the real signal available today via the shared GenAI operation-duration histogram's error.type dimension. See docs/rfcs/2026-09-03-guardrails-pii-regex-classifier.md.
